workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.languageDescription: The default interface language for members who have not chosen their own, and the language employees write in when their output language is set to “Workspace default”.
workspace.timezoneDescription: Used for project deadlines and health, and other dates of this workspace.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Guards are on by default: prompt-injection screening on tool results and secret/PII leakage checks on outputs.
safety.guardsDisableConfirm: Disable guards? This is not recommended.
safety.demoModeHint: Scripted runs with zero tokens and no network calls; same SSE events.
safety.require2fa: Require two-factor authentication for Owners and Admins
safety.require2faHint: They must set up an authenticator app before they can use the workspace. Only an Owner can change this.
safety.require2faDisableConfirm: Stop requiring two-factor authentication for Owners and Admins?

claude.title: Claude credential
claude.description: Each workspace uses its own credential. A run receives only this workspace's credential, only while it runs. Subscription tokens come from claude setup-token.

connect.title: Connect with a Claude account
connect.help: Sign in at claude.com with the Claude subscription (Pro/Max) this workspace should use. The server creates a 1-year token for this workspace only and stores it encrypted; you never see or copy it.
connect.step1: Open the Claude sign-in page and sign in with the account to use.
connect.step2: Claude then shows a code. Copy all of it and paste it here.
connect.orPaste: Or paste a token or API key yourself

error.busy: Several sign-ins are running on this server right now. Try again in a minute.
error.no_link: Claude Code did not show a sign-in link. Try again; if it keeps failing, the server may not reach claude.com.
error.invalid_code: Claude did not accept the code (wrong, incomplete or expired). Start again and copy the whole code.
error.timeout: The sign-in was not finished within 10 minutes. Start again.
error.cli_failed: Claude Code stopped before a token was created. Start again.
error.worker_restarted: The server restarted during the sign-in. Start again.

email.description: Used for send_email / send_invoice and notifications. The password never leaves the server.
email.presetHelp: Fills in host, port and TLS for the provider. Pick “Other server” to type them yourself.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: When approvals are waiting or a task finishes.
notifications.notifyEmailHelp: Every member already gets email at their own login address, as set under Account → Notifications. Add a shared address (e.g. ops@company.com) to also receive a copy of every notification there.
notifications.webhookHelp: The webhook receives JSON {payload}. It is also the target of the irreversible post_webhook tool.

integrations.title: MCP servers
integrations.description: Connect remote (Streamable HTTP) MCP servers. Tokens are encrypted and never sent to the browser or the model. Grant a server per employee as {grant}; its tools are classified by verb (read/list/search = reversible, anything else = irreversible → approval).
integrations.testOk: Connected: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} ({reversible} reversible)
integrations.oauthHint: For servers that sign you in (OAuth): enter a name and the server URL, then sign in on the server's page. Workforce OS keeps the access token fresh.
integrations.importedDisabled: Imported — add the token to enable
integrations.oauthConfirmTitle: Sign in to this MCP server?
integrations.oauthConfirmDescription: You are connecting {host}. Check where you will sign in and what access is asked for before you continue.
integrations.oauthScopesDefault: The server's default access (no scopes named).
integrations.oauthOtherSite: Careful: the sign-in page {as} is on a different site than the MCP server {mcp}. Continue only if you expected this provider.

oauthResult.invalid_state: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start again from Connect with OAuth.
oauthResult.denied: The sign-in was cancelled on the MCP server.
oauthResult.failed: Could not finish signing in to the MCP server. Try again.
oauthResult.forbidden: Only a workspace Owner can connect MCP servers.

pricing.title: Published price table
pricing.description: 1 credit = {usd}. Every LLM step is charged from this table, so you can forecast cost before running.

members.title: Members
members.description: Owner: everything incl. allow-lists & pricing · Admin: employees, approvals, settings · Member: tasks, chat, clients · Viewer: read-only.
members.createdPrompt: User created. Share this one-time password securely:
members.resetPrompt: New one-time password (they must change it at next sign-in). Share it securely:
members.resetConfirm: Reset the password for {email}? Their current password and sessions stop working.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Immutable (append-only, enforced by a database trigger): approvals, permission changes, credential changes, kill-switch use.

repositories.title: Git repositories
repositories.description: Workspace-mode employees work on these repositories in their sandbox. The platform clones, pushes and opens pull requests with the token; employees never see it.
repositories.tokenHelp: Needed for private repositories, pushing and pull requests. Use a fine-grained token limited to this repository (contents + pull requests). Stored encrypted; only its last 4 characters are shown.
repositories.newTokenHelp: Leave empty to keep the current token. A new one replaces it at once (the old one is not kept).
repositories.removeToken: Remove the token (only for public repositories)

emailPolicy.title: Outgoing email
emailPolicy.description: Limits for the email and invoices your employees send. Notifications to your team are not affected.
emailPolicy.pauseHelp: Nothing employees send goes out; each attempt shows in the outbox as failed, so you can send it again later.
emailPolicy.dailyLimitHelp: Emails per day (counted from midnight in the workspace's time zone). Past the limit, attempts fail until tomorrow.

usageBudget.title: Estimated Claude usage
usageBudget.description: A Claude subscription token does not report its plan usage, so the dashboard estimates it from the spend of workforce-os runs. Display only: the estimate never pauses work or sends warnings.
usageBudget.budgetHelp: The API-equivalent spend you treat as 100% of the window. Used until Claude reports a real value to calibrate from. Leave empty for none.

source.default: default until Claude reports a weekly reset

usageBudget.scheduleHelp: Used when Claude has not reported the current weekly reset time. Set both day and hour, or leave both automatic.
usageBudget.invalid: Enter a positive amount, or leave it empty.

shareLinks.title: View-only links
shareLinks.description: A link someone without an account can open to look around: the dashboard, the office, employees, divisions, tasks, goals and apps. Chat, approvals, mail, clients, knowledge and settings stay closed, and nothing can be changed. The link works until it expires or you revoke it.
shareLinks.label: For whom
shareLinks.createdOnce: Copy the link now: it is shown only once.
shareLinks.revokeConfirm: Revoke the link for "{label}"? Whoever has it loses access at once.
shareLinks.opens: {count, plural, =0 {not opened} one {opened once} other {opened # times}}
